rows.missing_or_conflicting: prior and noise variances: their sum (2) and a range for the noise variance (1 to 1.5) are known
rows.consequence: conditional mean between y/4 and y/2
rows.question: What is the measurement-noise variance per sample? (stated range 1.0 to 1.5)
rows.independent_check: independent batch conditioning gives gains 0.250 and 0.500 for the two admissible completions; both have measurement variance 2

rows.missing_or_conflicting: same as above; a mean-square error below 0.65 is requested
rows.consequence: a single gain can meet the level for every split
rows.independent_check: independent: the released first gain 0.250 gives error 0.375 and 0.625 at the two extreme admissible splits; the error is affine in the split, so these are the largest values

rows.consequence: none: the initial-error terms vanish in the limit
rows.independent_check: independent worst case after 400 steps: 0.052130 (zero initial error) vs 0.052130 (initial error 1 rad, 50 rad/s); claimed ultimate bound 0.052130

rows.consequence: none for a steady-state (k -> infinity) statement: the gain and its limiting covariance do not depend on it
rows.independent_check: Riccati iteration from two very different initial covariances converges to the same gain (difference 7.1e-15); equals the released gain to 4.2e-10

rows.consequence: none for the estimate; only the weaker (linear-estimator) claim is made
rows.independent_check: Monte Carlo error variance of the released gain: 4.866e-05 (Gaussian) and 4.844e-05 (uniform), reported 4.870e-05; claim type lmmse

rows.case: missing hard bound on the measurement error
rows.consequence: the guaranteed limit depends on it
rows.question: What is the largest possible measurement error (a hard bound, not an RMS value)?
rows.independent_check: the design certified for V = 0.0001 has independent worst case 0.0521 <= 0.2, but 0.6151 > 0.2 if the true bound is 0.002

rows.case: RMS noise level given, guaranteed limit requested
rows.missing_or_conflicting: hard measurement-error bound (an RMS value is not one)
rows.consequence: no hard bound follows from an RMS value
rows.question: What is the largest possible measurement error (a hard bound, not an RMS value)?
rows.independent_check: a zero-mean two-point noise with values +-a/sqrt(p), probability p/2 each, has RMS a for every p in (0, 1] and magnitude a/sqrt(p), which is unbounded as p -> 0

rows.case: measurement bound known only as a range
rows.missing_or_conflicting: value of the bound inside [5e-5, 2e-3] rad
rows.consequence: certified for the lower part of the range only
rows.question: Is the hard bound on the measurement error at most 0.00137968? If yes, a certified design exists for the stated requirement; if it can be larger, no candidate is verified.
rows.independent_check: at the threshold 1.380e-03 the released design has independent worst case 0.1994 <= 0.2 at step 140; at 1.05 x threshold the disposition is NO_VERIFIED_CANDIDATE

rows.case: sample period stated as a range
rows.consequence: model, gains and certificate are period-specific
rows.question: What is the exact sample/update period? (stated range: 0.001 to 0.002 s)
rows.independent_check: an observer built for 1 ms, driven by error-free data of a 2 rad/s motion: velocity error 0.00e+00 when the true period is 1 ms, 2.00 rad/s when it is 2 ms

rows.case: deadline added after an omission was harmless
rows.consequence: with a deadline the initial error matters
rows.question: Is the initial velocity estimate error at most 33134.6? If yes, a certified design exists for the stated requirement; if it can be larger, this certificate family cannot meet it.
rows.independent_check: first decision RELEASE (initial error irrelevant for an ultimate limit); after a 5 ms deadline is added the coordinator asks; the earlier design has independent worst case 35.2 rad/s at 5 ms for an admissible initial error of 100 rad/s; once that bound is supplied a different (faster) design is released (RELEASE), with independent worst case 0.171 rad/s at 5 ms

rows.missing_or_conflicting: evidence that the trajectory stays in the stated ranges
rows.consequence: the mismatch bound holds only inside the ranges
rows.question: What ensures the trajectory stays inside the stated operating ranges (mechanical limit, saturation argument, or an assumption you accept)?
rows.independent_check: model mismatch at the edge of the range (4 rad/s): 15.3 rad/s^2; at 40 rad/s: 118.2 rad/s^2, above the bound used inside the range

rows.missing_or_conflicting: whether the value is a spectral density or a per-step covariance
rows.consequence: the two readings differ by a factor of order Ts
rows.question: Is the process-noise value a continuous spectral density or a per-step covariance?
rows.independent_check: independent quadrature: trace of the discrete covariance is 7.043e-03 if the value is a spectral density and 4.297e-03 if it is a per-step covariance (Ts = 2.0 s)

rows.case: discrete model and a different stated period
rows.consequence: a discrete model cannot be re-sampled without the continuous one
rows.independent_check: A = [[1, 0.1], [0, 1]] is the 0.1 s transition; at 0.05 s the transition would be [[1, 0.05], [0, 1]], which is not the supplied matrix

rows.case: timestamps disagree with the stated period
rows.missing_or_conflicting: (conflict) data recorded every 2 ms, request states 1 ms
rows.consequence: the gains and the certificate are period-specific
rows.independent_check: the release for 1 ms is withdrawn for these data (timing_conflict); the same records with matching 1 ms timestamps are processed

rows.case: transient cap below the later tolerance
rows.missing_or_conflicting: none (the cap applies at every sample, the tolerance after the deadline)
rows.consequence: at t = 0 one position reading carries no velocity information
rows.independent_check: independent: the admissible initial velocities span +-2.0 rad/s around the initial estimate, so every estimate is at least 2.0 rad/s from one of them at t = 0, above the cap 0.1

rows.case: total and additive disturbance bounds both stated
rows.missing_or_conflicting: none (two statements bound the same acceleration error)
rows.independent_check: with the exact nominal model the acceleration error is the additive disturbance, bounded by 5; the released design has independent worst case 0.0521 rad/s at 0.1 s with that bound
